changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpricelistsetup AS SELECT pls.id, pls.facility_id, pls.type, pls.payer_id, pls.name, pls.version_number, pls.effective_from, pls.effective_to, pls.status, pls.currency, pls.description, pls.is_active, pls.created_by, pls.created_date, pls.last_modified_by, pls.last_modified_date FROM public.price_list_setup pls;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpricelistsetup TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpricelistsetup FROM report_user;
